0022600205.text: The Washington Wizards (4-6, 2nd in the Southeast and 8th in the East, on a three-game losing streak) visit the Detroit Pistons (6-2, 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East) for Washington's 11th game of the season, with the Wizards 2-4 on the road and the Pistons 2-1 at home. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 Washington lost the season series 1-3, including a 117-95 loss in Washington on March 19, 2026. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain).
